title: Structural distinguishers for Friet-PC beyond 14 rounds
summary: Full diffusion is reported after seven forward and six inverse rounds, but resistance to structural distinguishers beyond 14 rounds remains conjectural and needs stronger bounds.

formal_statement.body: For the Friet-PC permutation, determine whether a structural distinguisher exists for more than 14 rounds when the adversary can access only one third of the permutation's input and output. The available analysis reports full diffusion after seven forward rounds and six inverse rounds, which suggests that structural distinguishers spanning more than 14 rounds should be difficult to construct; the unresolved alternative is to substantiate this conjectured resistance with stronger bounds. [S1]

scope.domain: Structural cryptanalysis of the Friet-PC permutation, focused on distinguishers and diffusion.
assumptions: The adversary can access only one third of the permutation's input and output
parameters: number of rounds, with the question concerning more than 14 rounds
forward and inverse diffusion depth, reported as seven and six rounds
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine whether a structural distinguisher exists for more than 14 rounds under the stated access restriction, or substantiate the conjectured resistance with stronger bounds.
